manual.title: Commander Manual
manual.intro: The essentials for keeping your force alive and the invasion moving east.

lines.0: Choose an available sector before its turn clock expires.
lines.1: Recruit, refill, and research between operations; new units may need a turn to arrive.
lines.2: The war clock advances when you end the strategic turn. Spend time deliberately.

lines.0: Reposition squads on the glowing deployment tiles, then start the battle.
lines.1: Select a unit and click a reachable tile to move. Select a visible enemy to prepare fire.
lines.2: Action points pay for movement and attacks; ammunition does not refill by itself.

lines.0: Drag or use the arrow keys to pan, and use the mouse wheel to zoom.
lines.1: Tab toggles the minimap; H, F1, or ? opens the battlefield help.
lines.2: Overwatch spends the rest of a unit's turn to fire at enemies that move into sight.

lines.0: Cover, elevation, flanking, morale, weather, and wounds all change combat odds.
lines.1: Use medics for wounded troops and supply vehicles for finite-ammo units.
lines.2: Retreat is safer from the starting zone; squads left outside it may be lost.
